zoe: Kickoff: rollout plan for 'sticky-tenant-eviction-safeguard' (keeps tenant session affinity during regional failovers and prevents accidental eviction). Need canary plan, A/B gating, and operator controls.

li: Proposal: dark-launch 48h, reserved-exempt tenants (up to 4) for manual validation, then 0.2% -> 1% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% with 48h stabilization windows. Use per-tenant bucketing.

omar: SRE concerns: track sticky_miss_rate (when affinity broken), eviction_count, and fallback_frequency. Primary metric = sticky_miss_rate for enterprise tenants.

li: Failure gates: sticky_miss_rate > 0.5% sustained 30m OR eviction_count increase > 20% vs baseline in 15m OR P95 latency jump > 25% -> auto-mute + rollback for affected tenants only.

zoe: Ops needs: per-tenant kill switch + emergency evict command: `./ops evict-tenant --tenant <id> --dry-run|--force`. Add to runbook.

omar: Add step to redact PII before saving dark-launch traces. Retention: dark logs 14d, sampled payloads for eval 45d.

li: A/B decision: randomize at tenant level, not per-request. We'll also do a small within-tenant experiment (QA-only opt-in) for request-level QA.

zoe: Flag example for engineers:
```
flag: sticky_eviction_safeguard_v1
rules:
  - type: dark_launch
    duration: 48h
  - type: manual_list
    tenants: ["enterprise-1","enterprise-2"]
    duration: 72h
  - type: random_tenant
    percent: 0.2
    duration: 48h
fallback_chain:
  - type: keep_affinity_degrade
  - type: region_failover
  - type: enqueue_request
```

ops-bot: Note: deploy window requested Fri 02:00-04:00 PT. Add extra smoke check for affinity headers.

li: QA: run short eval suite after each ramp to verify session continuity and run synthetic cross-region failover test. Collect 2000 cross-region samples per cohort.

omar: Automated rollback behavior: only flip off flag for tenants exhibiting breach; notify #eng-oncall; page if >5 tenants auto-rolled back.

zoe: Customer comms: prepare opt-in email + in-app toggle for manual tenants. CS wants a separate escalation path.

deploy-bot: Scheduled: Fri 02:00-04:00 PT. Will post smoke results to thread.

zoe: I'll draft the rollout checklist with the above and request final sign-off by EOD tomorrow. :thumbsup:
